propositions: the refusal in _pai_check_config must be replaced with validation; base_url and api_key are already parsed in config.py but runtime construction fails

registering an openai builder in the provider factory allows rebar to inject base_url into OpenAIProvider for custom endpoints like Ollama/LMStudio while keeping provider selection explicit via REBAR_LLM_MODEL_PROVIDER

the builder must override the provider's model_profile staticmethod to withdraw supports_json_schema_output=True and return False, because an arbitrary OpenAI-compatible server has no obligation to implement strict json_schema output

conditional registration (only when cfg.base_url is set) preserves the lazy model-STRING path for bare openai strings without base_url, keeping the openai SDK optional at runtime and preventing test breakage
the profile override must ride the Provider subclass, not OpenAIChatModel(profile=...), because rebar's S1 seam returns a Provider and pydantic-ai's infer_model builds the model itself
